description: This file defines the ModuleService class which provides methods for managing modules within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving module lists and updating module statuses.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling module-related operations such as retrieving and updating modules.

methods.name: getModuleDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ModuleDao.

methods.name: setModuleDao
methods.description: Sets the ModuleDao instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of modules, such as enabling or disabling them based on provided input.
